name: ComplexFuncBench
intro: ComplexFuncBench针对复杂函数调用设计，涵盖五个真实场景，涉及多步调用和参数约束。要求模型进行长参数填写、参数值推理和处理128k长上下文。基准还提出了自动评估框架ComplexEval，用于量化复杂函数调用任务表现。
build_method: 43个旅行API人工修正, GPT-4o粗生成, 100条资深精标模板, 十倍泛化与初级标注
metric: Success Rate, Call Accuracy, Completeness, Correctness
task_type: 复杂函数调用, 多步旅行预订
eval_feature: 多步与约束调用, 参数推理, 长参数, 128K上下文, ComplexEval
task_type_en: Complex function calling, multi-step travel booking
build_method_en: Manual correction of 43 travel APIs, GPT-4o coarse generation, 100 senior-annotated templates, tenfold generalization with junior annotation
eval_feature_en: Multi-step constrained calls, parameter reasoning, long values, 128K context, ComplexEval
intro_en: ComplexFuncBench is designed for complex function calls, covering five real-world scenarios involving multi-step calls and parameter constraints. It requires models to handle long parameter filling, parameter value reasoning, and processing 128k-length contexts. The benchmark also introduces an automatic evaluation framework, ComplexEval, to quantify performance on complex function call tasks.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.10132 Sections 2–3 and the official repository. ComplexFuncBench starts from 43 real-time Booking.com/RapidAPI functions across hotel, flight, attraction, car-rental, and taxi domains; the authors manually correct incomplete or wrong descriptions. GPT-4o first generates 1,000 preliminary queries and call paths. Senior annotators select 100 relatively complete samples, rewrite queries, add/remove/reorder calls to the shortest complete path, fix parameter errors, remove overlapping functions, delete API results that cause ambiguous downstream values, and quality-check all templates. GPT-4o creates nine variants per template and junior annotators fill parameter values and disambiguate responses, yielding 1,000 samples: 600 single-domain and 400 cross-domain. During evaluation the model iteratively predicts calls and receives annotated responses. ComplexEval checks function/required-parameter/type format, maps predicted to gold calls with bge-large-en embeddings and the Hungarian algorithm, and applies exact, response-based, or GPT-4o semantic equivalence. It reports task Success Rate and Call Accuracy; GPT-4o separately scores final-response Completeness and Correctness from 0 to 2.
